notes.title: Steam Trading Cards, Badges, and Rewards
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye!

I've just added [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] to 1428: Shadows over Silesia! If you like to customize your profile, collect badges, or just have something from your favorite game outside of the actual gameplay, this might put a smile on your face.

Steam Trading Cards are earned through gameplay and can be used to create [b]badges [/b]– five tiers of chalices styled after the game, ranging from simple wooden ones to richly decorated metal and gold ones.

Along with this, you can unlock rewards for your Steam profile:
[list][*] I’ve prepared [b]four new profile backgrounds[/b], inspired by the game’s environment and graphic style, with a darker atmosphere.
[*] There are also [b]10 emoticons[/b] available – ranging from heraldic symbols to items you know from the game.[/list]
If you're an avid collector or just enjoy customizing your Steam profile, you can now bring a piece of Silesia from 1428 to your profile. And if that’s not your thing – the game remains, of course, exactly the same.

Thanks for playing!
Petr Kubíček aka KUBI Games

notes.title: DLC on the Horizon and New Game Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a while, I'm back with exciting news and the announcement of a new game!

1428: Shadows over Silesia is now available for $19.99 (down from $29.99), boasting Steam player ratings of over 85% (161 reviews, including retail editions, with 139 positive). The game is still in development, receiving regular bug fixes and community translation updates. But there's more to share! I'm thrilled to reveal that pre-production for new DLC content has begun. While it's too early for specifics, stay tuned for more details next year, including a teaser trailer.

[h3]New game – Kubikon 3D[/h3]
Introducing a fresh project I've embarked on. It's a casual puzzle game fusing elements from Tetris, Arkanoid, Sokoban, and other classics. With dozens of levels, Ranked mode allows global competition with leaderboard comparisons, while Random mode guarantees virtually unlimited replayability with cubes rearranged uniquely each time. Creatives can unleash their ideas using the built-in editor to create and share levels. Catch the demo during Steam Next Fest, and the full game releases by the end of Q2 2024. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703100/Kubikon_3D

Thank you for your attention and enduring support!
Petr Kubicek, aka KUBI Games

notes.title: Introduction of playable characters
notes.content:
You will experience the story of the game from the point of view of the two main characters, Hynek, a grumpy Hussite hetman who doesn't hesitate to swear or mess around with anything, and Lothar, a Hospitaller knight, a man of good education and manners who stands alongside his brethren in the front line of the Silesian defense. Each has their own motivations and views of the world around them, and different equipment and abilities. The time has come to introduce them a little more closely.

[h2]Hynek 'The Fox'[/h2]
An orphan raised by his grandmother at the court of Jobst of Luxemburg in Brno. Hynek embraced Hussite ideals, which gave him the support he thought he had long lost. In the spring of 1428, in Silesia, he commanded his troop as one of the many hetmans of the Hussite field army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36858697/262363926d8c7cd5b6183d528ae89b086921e7a9.png[/img]

[h2]Lothar von Reichenstein[/h2]
A young Silesian nobleman from a castle at the foot of the Golden Mountains. In defiance of his father, he joined the Order and renounced all his inheritance in favour of his younger sister Anna. Lothar joined the commandery of Knights Hospitaller in Small Oels and soon gained the trust of both his superiors and his brothers. His calm nature, sharp mind and excellent swordsmanship made him an indispensable member of the Order who could always be relied upon and whose judgement must be taken into account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36858697/1fa834bfddb3578b4a7f6da52d6b0f5d1bfff5e8.png[/img]

[b]The game is coming out on October 4 for PC.[/b]

notes.title: Full accessibility for the blind gamers
notes.content:
It was bound to come at some point. It has come now! A new era of gaming for blind gamers is about to begin, and it will kick off with 1428: Shadows over Silesia. It may seem strange that a small one-man studio from the Czech Republic would come up with this, but when none of the world's leading developers was going to seize this opportunity for a long time, I decided to take up the challenge.

Today I am proud to announce that the [b]upcoming action-adventure game 1428: Shadows over Silesia will be fully accessible to blind players[/b]. This will make it the first game ever on PC and the second overall (after [i]The Last of Us Part II[/i]) to bring full blind support to an adventure of this scale. 

We're not talking about just some of the in-game text being read or about some kind of rudimentary navigation. The game will bring all-new revolutionary elements that will allow the blind to enjoy a full experience not only of the story, dialogue and exploring the environment, but also stealth or combat, including large scale battles! Although the accessibility in [i]TLOU2[/i] was a tremendous success and won numerous awards, Shadows over Silesia takes everything to a whole new level never seen before. 

To mark the occasion, a new audio trailer for the visually impaired has just been released! The very first of its kind:[previewyoutube=lxsQWzbPIIE;full][/previewyoutube]
Special site for the blind: https://blind.shadows1428.com

[h3]Brief summary of the accessibility features the game will offer[/h3]

[u]Full narration of all in-game text[/u]
[list]
[*] Including reading pop-up hints, character properties, active quests, journal entries and inventory
[*] Closed captions in cut-scenes
[*] Subtitle narration for non-dubbed languages
[*] Ability to skip forward and backward in text
[*] Support for different screen readers
[/list]
[u]Special environment descriptions[/u]
[list]
[*] Most locations have their own text descriptions, so even the blind can enjoy the game's dark atmosphere while receiving additional information they would otherwise miss
[/list]
[u]Advanced navigational features[/u]
[list]
[*] Navigation to important story points, characters and even custom points that can be added on demand in an unlimited quantity
[*] Reporting of the remaining distance to the destination
[*] Compass narration as well as a coordinate system
[*] Assistance with turning towards objects or characters
[/list]
[u]Sonar[/u]
[list]
[*] A revolutionary feature that allows the blind to freely explore and navigate the game world
[*] Sonar also includes friendly and enemy characters and determines their locations
[*] Alerts for traps or destructible barriers
[/list]
[u]A large number of audio cues[/u]
[list]
[*] Alerts for objects and interesting interactions. Many of these provide additional sounds to let the player know what is around them right as they first hear it
[*] Alerts for the beginning and end of cutscenes, low health, leaving an area, and many other situations
[*] Warnings about enemies
[*] Signals to attack or defend
[/list]
[u]Optional simplification of some mechanics[/u]
[list]
[*] Accessible combat, including large scale battles
[*] Accessible stealth that maintains its atmosphere as well as difficulty
[*] More time to complete timed events
[/list]
And a great deal of other extra goodies
